title: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

reports.title: Parkview High receives 4th AI-generated bomb threat this year
Hoax phone call at Gwinnett high school causes lockdown; campus cleared
Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

summary:
Parkview High School in Gwinnett County, Georgia received its fourth AI-generated bomb threat of the school year on Monday. The school was placed on lockdown as a precaution, then later returned to normal operations. In a letter to parents, school police said the latest incident follows a pattern seen in recent threats involving the use of a masked phone number.

Gwinnett County school police are working with the Georgia Bureau of Investigation and the FBI to find who is responsible. No arrests have been made and no suspect has been identified. Authorities have not announced any further steps, but the investigation is ongoing. The threats have all been AI-generated, according to police.
title_en: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown
